note: Cards of the two card sections of the Gallery page (the families are generated by the page, see SECTIONS in src/ui/gallery/model.mjs). featured: single regions, each shown once. found: one region per shape up to the 12 symmetries of the grid (rotations, reflections and translations) and per region type, for every symmetric finite region with |x|, |d| <= 5000, with the number of the 12 symmetries of the grid that map the shape onto itself (symmetry), taken from a census of that square (the occurrence nearest to the origin, ordered by area and genus ascending, then symmetry descending), an optional short description (text). kind token: a token of data/tokens.json. kind witness: a file of data/witnesses/ (name without .json). kind natural: a region found in the grid, a cell (x, d) of the region (a featured natural card is also in data/natural_examples.json, a found card is checked by its flood fill alone). colour 1, -1 or 0 is the region type. genus, area and symmetry are the stated numbers, each card checks them in the browser.
